src/runner/codex.ts parseCodexResult: stop rejecting status success with empty artifactPaths for read-only roles, and stop mapping a revise verdict onto a transport failure
src/runner/cursor.ts: the same two corrections at cursor.ts:286

Supervisor handling so a revise verdict routes to the revision path rather than the runner-failure retry path
